answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted peer attestation with slashing. Every agent locks a token bond; its influence equals stake multiplied by a reputation factor that only accrues through a long history of honest, verifiable work. Spinning up a thousand fake identities is nearly free, but capitalizing and aging each one is not — the attacker's cost grows with every identity, like shale where each pigment layer must be deposited over time. An ember of effort buys nothing: honest agents amortize a single costly history while sybils must pay per copy.
